shadowRaw.$description: D-029 (dial-braun-rederivation, supersedes D-008's absolute ban) — elevation.* is RESERVED for layers that truly float above content: modal, popover, toast, dropdown (unchanged from D-008). raised.*/inset.* are NEW under D-029 — structural depth cues for the control/input component classes only (system/FORM.md), never decorative, never on surface/display/separator classes. Colors use neutral.800 (#1D1C17-family, the closest match to the old shadow ink's darkness after D-028's neutral-ramp hue correction). Directional: offset toward lower-right, matching the measured cast-shadow direction on the actual Braun reference image (a real pixel scan around a raised knob found the body darkening below/below-left of the control, i.e. a light source from upper-left casting a shadow down-right) — a SINGLE directional shadow, not a neumorphic dual-tone highlight+shadow pair, because direct measurement of the reference's own knob fill found no internal gradient at all (see system/FORM.md's 'A correction the measurement forced' section). This is the LIGHT-theme shadow primitive; dark theme declares its own composite directly in semantic/dark.json.
